thread:
Michelle: Quick PSA — someone left a half-empty bottle of maple syrup in the top pantry shelf and it spilled a little. Can we toss/clean? sticky mess. :sweat_smile:
Hassan: I saw that. I wiped most of it off but didn’t want to move the bottle — it looks sticky under the rice canister too.
Jordan: Is it the big glass bottle or one of those airport-sized bottles?
Michelle: Big reusable glass one with a white cap, near the cereal. I think it’s leaking from the cap.
Sophia: I’ll grab gloves and paper towels in 5. Also, can we please label specialty items? Someone takes the oat milk sometimes and leaves the container open. :pray:
Carlos: Can we print a small shelf tag instead of handwritten post-its? I can put a template in the kitchen.
Michelle: Love that. Maybe a sticker: "Shared — please reseal (oat/almond/milk)". Short and polite.
Hassan: +1 on template. Also reminder: if you finish a bottle, write "EMPTY" in bold on the cap, saves guesses.
Jordan: small poll idea — do we want a weekly snack run or sign-up rotation? I can coordinate if people prefer a list.
Sophia: Weekly run would be great. Alternating volunteers so it’s not always the same people. :raised_hands:
Carlos: I’ll make the shelf label template. What text? suggestions: 1) Item name 2) Owner (optional) 3) Date opened 4) "Reseal after use"
Michelle: Perfect. Maybe add a QR that links to a short kitchen etiquette doc? (1 page)
kitchen-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Kitchen tidy check" every Friday at 3pm. :bell:
Hassan: Omg bot, thank you. That should help catch messes before weekend.
Jordan: Also — who took the small cocktail maple bottle? It vanished yesterday. :eyes:
Sophia: Not me. I’ll check the desk drawers, people hide snacks.
Carlos: Template ready in #eng-commons: ```Shelf Label
Item: __________
Opened: __/__/__
Reseal: YES
Owner: ________ (optional)```
Michelle: Amazing — can we get a roll of clear shipping labels to print? They’ll stick better than tape.
Hassan: I have a spare roll, I’ll drop it in the kitchen tonight.
Jordan: Vote: weekly snack run on Fridays? :one: yes :two: no
Sophia: :one:
Carlos: :one:
Hassan: :one:
Michelle: :one:
Jordan: consensus = weekly run. I’ll post a volunteer signup sheet. Thanks y'all. :coffee:
